description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView, which provides a user interface for managing a list of voice wake words used in the app. Users can add, remove, reset to defaults, and edit wake words, with changes being saved and synchronized with the app model.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view allowing users to configure voice wake words, with features for adding, deleting, resetting, and editing trigger words, and syncing updates with application preferences.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if the list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding to a specific trigger word at the given index for editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves current trigger words, sanitizes them, cancels ongoing sync tasks, and initiates synchronization with the app model.
